title: Business English Conversation 11:  Delayed Flight
content: 1. to be somewhere on time: to arrive at or before the scheduled time - I'm stuck in traffic, so I won't be there on time. - I will be there on time. Don't worry. 2. to have no choice: to have no other options about what to do - We need to file for bankruptcy. We have no choice. - My wife got a good job in New York, so I have to move with her. I have no choice. 3. to catch a flight: to get on a flight - I have to catch a flight at 9 am tomorrow. - Are you late? Will you be able to catch your flight?
